raw_plan.interpretation: One English acquisition email brief for cohort-based course creators and coaches who need student video testimonials before their next launch. The reader's relationship with Senja is unknown. The email should earn a self-serve evaluation through free signup, rather than assume an existing account or promise student submissions. The alternative is a replacement proposition for the same slot, not an additional email.

intent.reason_now: The selected audience needs student results on camera before its next cohort launch; no specific launch date is established.
intent.desired_action: Create a free Senja account and test a structured student testimonial request.

raw_plan.reader: A cohort-based course creator or coach evaluating a way to request student video testimonials for an upcoming launch.
raw_plan.reader_segment: A course creator or coach who needs student results on camera before the next cohort launch
raw_plan.reader_scope: Cohort-based course operators within the selected audience; solution-aware, with unknown tools, collection history and relationship to Senja.
raw_plan.promise: Try a structured student testimonial request before committing to a paid collection workflow.
raw_plan.orientation: Senja is testimonial collection and sharing software for small course and coaching teams that need student video proof for recurring launches and sales materials.
raw_plan.arc: Connect the upcoming launch to one practical collection test, explain the request mechanism, then offer free signup with the 15-testimonial allowance.
raw_plan.sequence_rationale: One email must carry the complete decision: why the workflow is relevant, what to try and what the free account permits. Structured collection leads because it directly supports the selected audience's need for student video proof without claiming to solve low response rates. No objection is assigned: concerns about pressure, incentive authenticity and format choice lack supported product answers. The alternative offers a different reason to evaluate Senja: presenting student proof that is already available.

emails.selection_reason: A structured request is a relevant, observable first test for a solution-aware cohort operator. The free allowance makes that test concrete without requiring a paid commitment or a promised submission rate.
emails.job: Get the reader to create a free account and try a structured request for student video testimonials.
emails.single_idea: Before the next cohort launch, test Senja by creating a structured testimonial form and inviting students to respond; the free tier allows up to 15 video or text testimonials.
emails.mechanism: After creating a free account, build a simple or multistep collection form, then invite students individually or in bulk and use follow-ups where appropriate. Try a prompt asking students to describe their starting point and what changed. Inspect whether the form supports the story you want to request; student participation remains a separate question. The documented 60 seconds applies to form creation, not receiving testimonials.

alternative_arguments.selection_reason: For an operator who already has permission to use student testimonials, assembling a shareable proof page offers an immediate evaluation of presentation rather than collection.
alternative_arguments.single_idea: If you already have student video testimonials to use, assemble them into a shareable Wall of Love with a CTA for prospective students.
alternative_arguments.mechanism: After free signup, import an existing student video testimonial you have permission to use. Senja includes built-in ad-free video hosting and lets you assemble testimonials into a Wall of Love with a CTA. Open the resulting page to inspect how the student story is presented. The free tier permits collection or import of up to 15 video or text testimonials.
alternative_arguments.belief_shift: Before: Senja may only be useful when requesting new testimonials. After: if student proof is already available, a free account can also be tested by presenting it on a shareable page.
must_not_say: Do not assume the recipient already has video testimonials or permission to publish them; make this route conditional.
Do not promise higher enrollment, conversion or trust.
Do not claim Senja obtains publication permission or verifies student results.
Do not promise HD video downloads on Free.
Do not introduce collection speed, incentives, integrations, AI case studies or competitor comparisons.
Do not claim guidance on avoiding pressure, preserving perceived authenticity or choosing a feedback format.
alternative_arguments.next_step_decision: Decide whether a Senja Wall of Love is a suitable way to present available student video proof for the next launch.
alternative_arguments.next_step_value: After signup, import available testimonials within the free allowance, use built-in video hosting and inspect a shareable Wall of Love with a CTA.
alternative_arguments.next_step_limit: This presentation test does not establish enrollment impact, rights to publish, new student participation or HD download availability.
alternative_arguments.subject_strategy: Make the opportunity to put existing student video proof on a shareable launch page concrete, without implying the recipient already has those videos.

events.subject: Test your student video testimonial request
events.preview_text: Build a collection form and try student invitations with a free Senja account.
events.body:
With Senja, you can create a student video testimonial request before your next cohort launch.

Senja is testimonial collection and sharing software. After creating a free account, you can build a simple or multistep collection form, invite students individually or in bulk, and send follow-ups where appropriate.

Start with a concrete prompt: ask students to describe their starting point and what changed during the program. That gives you a specific request to try, with room for students to tell their own stories.

The free tier lets you collect **up to 15 video or text testimonials**. You can evaluate the form and invitation workflow before committing to a paid plan.

events.message: Email 1, draft 1: "Give student videos a shareable page"
events.subject: Give student videos a shareable page
events.preview_text: Test how existing student testimonials look together before your next cohort launch.
events.body:
Senja turns testimonials into a shareable Wall of Love.

It’s testimonial collection and sharing software. If you already have student video testimonials and permission to publish them, you can test how they look on a page for prospective students.

After free signup, you can import an existing testimonial, assemble your Wall of Love and add a call to action. Open the resulting page to see how the student story is presented alongside that next step.

The free account lets you collect or import **up to 15 video or text testimonials**. That gives you room to evaluate the presentation for your next cohort launch before committing to a paid workflow.
